translations.web: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
translations.bsb: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
translations.kjv: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
translations.asv: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
